purpose: measure ground-truth visibility, model detection, confirmatory-gate sensitivity, materiality-gate attrition, bounded discovery sensitivity and full-pipeline specificity for small noisy sparse conditional edge before B2-06 scientific execution

diagnostic_meaning.GROUND_TRUTH_VISIBLE: ground-truth-aware reviewer metric only: the injected support-conditional mean shift is statistically distinguishable from zero under the frozen block-aware uncertainty rule; never available to discovery selection
diagnostic_meaning.MODEL_DETECTED: candidate model has positive incremental prediction with block-bootstrap lower bound > 0 and placebo separation; materiality and era-stability gates are not required
diagnostic_meaning.STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY: all strict gates except the 2 percent pooled relative-MAE materiality gate
diagnostic_meaning.STRICT_PASS: all strict gates including the unchanged 2 percent pooled relative-MAE materiality gate

ORACLE_CONFIRMATORY.question: given the correct candidate feature without privileged support labels, where does the path visibility-to-model-to-confirmation-to-materiality lose power

BLIND_LIBRARY_DISCOVERY.question: within a bounded preregistered library, can the full search-select-evaluate process identify true/proxy structure without selecting pure placebo structure

dgp.independence: U1, U2, mechanism-state transition uniforms and RAW innovations are mutually independent within a world; all world RNG streams are independently namespaced

baseline.realism_limitation: V1 does not calibrate candidate absorption of baseline-model misspecification

mechanism.iid_support_arm: not primary; no iid-support methodology conclusion may substitute for the clustered-support primary arm

effect_scale_reference.ceiling_interpretation: the 2 percent materiality gate is expected to be unreachable for the frozen positive ladder under perfect-oracle pooled MAE; this is intentional diagnostic information and may not be hidden or used to change beta after outcomes

monte_carlo.boundary_policy: rates whose Wilson interval straddles a frozen decision threshold are INDETERMINATE; no hard methodology PASS/FAIL may be inferred from them
monte_carlo.failed_world_denominator_policy: failed worlds remain in denominator and make aggregate calibration INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION unless the exact frozen run is reproduced under the same code identity before result opening

candidate_library.note: F01 is renamed proxy carrier and F03 remains exact true feature only in semantic authority; the evaluator receives opaque IDs and a separate evaluator-visible matrix in which F01 is a one-step-lagged trigger S_(t-1), not S_t

metrics.SUPPORT_COVERAGE: mean(TRUE_TRIGGER==1) on scored rows; reporting/ground-truth diagnostics only
metrics.SUPPORT_CONDITIONAL_MEAN_AE_IMPROVEMENT: mean(AE_IMPROVEMENT | TRUE_TRIGGER==1); ground-truth diagnostic only and never available to evaluator selection
metrics.SUPPORT_RUN_LENGTHS: contiguous scored-row run lengths where TRUE_TRIGGER==1
metrics.EFFECTIVE_SUPPORT_N: N_positive / (1 + 2*sum_{k=1..K} rho_k) using positive-support indicator autocorrelations through first non-positive pair cutoff; reporting diagnostic, not a gate

ground_truth_visibility.baseline_residual: Y-BASE_PRED from the same chronological baseline predictions used by evaluation
ground_truth_visibility.uncertainty: 500 replicate contiguous-50-row block bootstrap on scored rows, preserving full rows and trigger labels
ground_truth_visibility.truth_access: artifact-generation diagnostic only; forbidden to candidate selection, candidate fitting, placebo, and discovery tie-breaking

strict_reference_gate.era_stability: mean_AE_improvement > 0 in at least 3 of 4 scored eras
strict_reference_gate.support_sanity: candidate-positive scored support finite, nonzero, >=50 rows
strict_reference_gate.STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY: primary_positive AND bootstrap_positive AND placebo_separation AND era_stability AND support_sanity

bootstrap.sampling: whole contiguous blocks with replacement, no block crosses era

placebo.operation: permute candidate labels separately within each scored era; Y/X1/X2/order fixed; refit same expanding-era procedure

discovery.selection_statistic: STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY candidates only, choose max MEAN_AE_IMPROVEMENT; exact ties ascending feature_id; none=>NO_CANDIDATE
discovery.NULL_false_positive: ANY_EDGE_DECLARED under NULL after full search-select-evaluate pipeline
discovery.interpretation: BLIND mode calibrates bounded discovery/search behavior, not independent confirmatory validation

acceptance.detection_floor: lowest difficulty region where MODEL_DETECTION Wilson upper bound <0.50 OR GROUND_TRUTH_VISIBLE Wilson upper bound <0.50, with reason label VISIBILITY_FLOOR or MODEL_FLOOR
acceptance.materiality_gate_diagnostic: report STRICT_PASS minus STRICT_PASS_EX_MATERIALITY and MATERIALITY_FRACTION_OF_ATTAINABLE; full STRICT_PASS is not the sole calibration success variable

b2_06_consequences.visibility_floor: negative market results in comparable effective-support regimes cannot be interpreted strongly as absence of edge
b2_06_consequences.model_floor: candidate family/evaluation sensitivity requires repair or explicit power caveat before interpreting comparable NO_PROMOTION
b2_06_consequences.materiality_only_failure: record that strict 2 percent pooled materiality suppresses statistically/model-detectable sparse edge; any future market-gate change requires separate outcome-blind preregistration and is not authorized by calibration itself
b2_06_consequences.indeterminate: no binary methodology claim; do not tune thresholds from the same calibration outcomes

anti_rescue: no lowering 2 percent materiality threshold after outcomes
no switching primary conclusion from one diagnostic layer to another after outcomes
no post-result candidate additions or proxy reclassification
execution_ceremony: implementation written using synthetic fixture tests only
implementation independently reviewed without production grid execution
any methodology change requires a new version
